text: I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 6, and her temperature has just come up at 39.6. I'm frightened to death if I'm honest. She's got a rash on her tummy and arms. I did the glass test like I've seen on the telly and the spots go pale when I press, they do fade. Her colour looks normal to me, lips are pink. She hasn't had any fit or shaking, nothing like that. Her mum and dad are away and I don't want to get this wrong. Please tell me what I should be doing
